§bSuper Pattern Maker§r

Turns an NEI search into Super Patterns: one pattern per machine holding every matching recipe (the cheapest from the machines you tick, never above your tier). Put a Super Pattern in an ME Interface or Crafting Input Buffer and every recipe on it becomes available.

§eSettings§r: config/superpatternmaker.cfg (max recipes per pattern, NC items as Programming Circuits).

§cRebalanced§r: Blank Super Patterns are tiered HV to UMV: 10 recipes at HV, 50% more each tier. The * search unlocks at IV.

§aTask§r: tick the box once you've read this.
